blocks.text: BAGUIO CITY, Philippines — The city’s giant Christmas tree and holiday decorations this year will incorporate recycled materials, Cordilleran cultural symbols and local artistic designs as part of the city’s push for sustainability and creative expression. According to City Tourism Officer Aloysius Mapalo, the Christmas tree, along with decorations along Session Road and at Malcolm Square, will follow the theme “A Glowing Journey through Circular Creativity,” highlighting the city’s circular economy advocacy, local culture and creativity. The proposed 11-meter-high Christmas tree, with a projected footprint of nine meters in diameter, will be an original art installation titled “Circular Story of Hope.” […]...
